findingsCorrected.finding: Tests of algebra and transport were not explicitly tied to the functions actually selected by job registration/execution plan. Added selected accumulator/combiner/finalizer, codec and consumer discovery plus verification that tests invoke actual merge/codec hooks.

Added a conditional engine-lifecycle decision: Hadoop 3.4.1 mapred combiner may run zero, once or repeatedly, so correctness cannot depend on one invocation. Mean state remains sum/count until final output.

Added concrete verifier blind spot: Beam 2.77.0 CombineFn.apply bypasses mergeAccumulators. A sequential helper can pass while a broken distributed merge remains untested. Added discriminating faulty-merge control and runner-test limit.

developmentCases.commonActorTask: Review and fix the aggregate selected by job.properties for partitioned inputs. Preserve the exact integer-sum contract and Java 16 baseline. Inspect the selected implementation and current tests. Restrict implementation changes to the selected job path; do not rewrite unused alternatives or add dependencies. Report executed checks and their limits.
developmentCases.commonPrerequisites: An isolated directory, existing javac/java supporting --release 16; no external dependencies. This fixture models selected local hooks, not an actual Hadoop/Beam runner.

commonActorFiles.contract.md: The batch returns the exact sum for one logical group. Inputs are non-negative integers <=1000, at most 10 records; all required partitions are present with no duplicate attempts. Any partition grouping and arrival order allowed by Job.run must preserve the total. Output is consumed as an integer total, not a maximum. Java target 16. Job registration is job.properties. Existing local check: javac --release 16 Job.java ExistingTest.java, then java ExistingTest. Selected-path run: java Job job.properties.
